# Scope Brief — Team Offsite Logistics

## 0. Document Control
- Status: Approved
- Scope owner: Operations Lead
- Accountable decision-maker: Head of People
- Prepared on: 2026-10-14
- Next review or change trigger: Venue contract execution or budget change >10%
- Operating surface: Non-durable / Portable chat
- Scope hash: sha256:d2d602dad349c9c9b2f703956246a3c81afc13056d7f1f9732fd89297f2913c1

## 1. Situation and Owner
- Current situation: Team has grown by 15 people across three cities; no in-person planning has occurred this fiscal year.
- Problem or opportunity: Team alignment and quarterly goals require a focused 2-day in-person workshop.
- Desired change: A 2-day hosted offsite with 100% attendee participation and zero venue overspend.
- Why now: Q1 planning window opens in November.
- Consequence of no action: Continued misalignment on cross-team dependencies and delayed roadmap.
- Primary beneficiary: Engineering and Product team leads
- Accountable decision-maker: Head of People
- Other materially relevant roles: Operations Coordinator (logistics)

## 2. Scope
### In scope
- Venue sourcing, booking, and on-site catering for 30 attendees
- Travel and lodging arrangements for 12 remote staff
- Workshop facilitation AV setup and breakout materials

### Conditional
- Evening team dinner — included only if venue total comes in $2k below budget

### Out of scope (Mandatory Invariant — C10)
- Content creation for breakout workshops (owned by respective team leads)
- Keynote speaker booking or honoraria
- Permanent AV equipment purchases

### External dependencies
- Corporate travel card credit limit increase (Finance)

## 3. Constraints and Definition of Done
### Constraints and assumptions (Mandatory Invariant — C10)
- Known — Total budget capped at $25,000 (Finance allocation).
- Assuming (untested) — Hotel group block available within walking distance of venue; impact if wrong: ground shuttle costs must be added to budget.
- Still need to check — Dietary restrictions for 4 new hires (Operations lead to poll by 2026-10-20).

### End-to-end scenario
Given 30 confirmed attendees, Operations bookings are finalized by Nov 1, remote staff receive travel itineraries 14 days in advance, and on-site check-in completes smoothly with badges and materials ready.

### Observable acceptance evidence
Signed venue contract, confirmed hotel block confirmation numbers, and approved purchase order.

### Edge or failure scenario
Severe weather cancels travel: cancellation insurance active; contract allows penalty-free reschedule within 60 days.

- Still need to check — Final attendee RSVP list from Sales (Owner: Sales VP, Due: 2026-10-18, Blocks: Final room block commit)

### Handoff
- Next action (Mandatory Invariant — C10): Issue RFP to three shortlisted downtown conference venues
- Action owner: Operations Coordinator
- Receiving person, discipline, or protocol: Facilities & Procurement
